summary: AccumulatorCompiler produces compatible/coalesce/NA-flag expressions for dimension pairs used during the accumulator build phase cross-join step.

key_classes.name: AccumulatorCompiler
key_classes.summary: Compiles three expression types per dimension: compile_compatible (can two rules coexist?), compile_coalesce (merged value), compile_coalesce_na_flag (both-wildcard flag). Supports EXACT, RANGE, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN only.

extension_points: Adding a new accumulator-compatible strategy: add cases to compile_compatible and compile_coalesce.
lifecycle_notes: GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN are always compatible — _compatible_threshold returns literal True.
RANGE coalesce computes intersection (max of mins, min of maxes) with full sentinel handling.
open_questions: String/set strategies (PREFIX, SUFFIX, CONTAINS, REGEX, SET_MEMBERSHIP, SET_EXCLUSION) are not yet supported.
